$comment: Canonical PrivateFPC deployment descriptor — mirrors @alejoamiras/private-fee-juice's canonical-deployment.json at 6.0.0, extended with the installed artifact's digest, the target-network identity pins, and the digest-keyed node-compat map. The address is derived from compiled bytecode + salt and is ONLY valid for this exact aztecVersion + artifact — depositing Fee Juice to a stale address is UNRECOVERABLE. The canonical salt is a fixed project constant from 5.0.0 onward. Machine-asserted by private-fuel.test.ts (derivation + digest + compat coherence + equality with the package's canonical-deployment.json) and consumed by check-fpc-version.ts (compat-gated version + digest + network-identity + live-class gate; an unpublished instance is green, a published one must carry the pinned class).

network.$comment: Hard identity pins for the ONE network this descriptor serves (the Sepolia-anchored 6.0.0-rc.3 testnet, verified live). A gate run against any other network is a wrong-network operator error, not a compat question.

compatibleNodeVersions.$comment: HUMAN-CURATED, digest-keyed: node versions this exact artifact (by sha256) may run against. A new artifact digest REQUIRES a fresh entry — the gate fails closed on a missing key. 6.0.0 = the artifact's own version; the reset 6.0.0 testnet node reports nodeVersion 6.0.0.
